title: Infinity Blade: iPhone Trailer
summary: IGN's 2010 trailer for Infinity Blade, an Unreal Engine fighting game for iPhone, iPad and iPod. It shows off gameplay and the visuals of the mobile game.
why: Cited as a benchmark of what mobile graphics could do in 2010, against which later WebGL games are compared.

quote.text: Still waiting to see a WebGL game that matches Infinity Blade
